rounds.response:
[Product X] is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with moderate to severe Condition X who have had an inadequate response to at least one prior systemic therapy for Condition X.  
Infusion‑related reactions: Serious and sometimes fatal infusion‑related reactions, including anaphylaxis, have occurred, most frequently during the first and second infusions; monitor patients during the infusion and for at least 1 hour after completion of the first and second infusions; if an infusion‑related reaction occurs, immediately interrupt or stop the infusion and institute appropriate medical therapy; consider premedication per institutional practice.  
Serious infections: Use may increase the risk of serious infections; do not initiate [Product X] in patients with active serious infection; discontinue [Product X] if a serious infection develops; screen for latent tuberculosis and hepatitis B in accordance with clinical guidelines before initiating therapy.  
Hepatic enzyme elevations: Obtain baseline alanine aminotransferase (ALT) and aspartate aminotransferase (AST) and monitor periodically during treatment; interrupt [Product X] for ALT or AST >3×ULN; discontinue [Product X] for persistent elevations >5×ULN or when ALT or AST elevations are accompanied by increased bilirubin or clinical signs of liver injury.  
Proposed as near label‑ready text for internal review; edits are intentionally minimal to follow the provided templates (mainly insertion of the product name and consolidation of bullets for readability); please provide trial incidence/timing data and any preferred boxed‑warning direction to finalize numeric language and placement.
